study type: Observational study (secondary analysis of two randomized crossover trials)
exposure: Use of closed-loop insulin delivery system
Mode of delivery (vaginal, elective Cesarean, emergency Cesarean)
outcome: Time in glucose target range during labor, delivery, and postpartum
cohort: Pregnant women with type 1 diabetes who chose to continue using closed-loop insulin delivery during labor, delivery, and postpartum (n=27)
finding: Closed-loop insulin delivery was feasible and resulted in high time in glucose target range during labor, delivery, and postpartum in women with type 1 diabetes.
mod_finding: Closed-loop insulin delivery performed well throughout vaginal, elective Cesarean, and emergency Cesarean deliveries.
